BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
(Order made under Article 83(3))
AUTHORITY FOR INFO-COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY
OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2026
In exercise of the power conferred by Article 83(3) of the Constitution of
Brunei Darussalam, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby makes
the following Order -
Citation

noLabel.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Authority for Info-communications

text.en:
1. This Order may be cited as the Authority for Info-communications
Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 2026.
Amendment of S 39/2001

noLabel.en: 2. The Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei

text.en:
2. The Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei
Darussalam Order, 2001 is amended by deleting "Info-communications"
wherever the word appears and by substituting "Infocommunications" therefor.
Saving and transitional provisions
3. (1) Any right, benefit, privilege, obligation or liability acquired, accrued or
incurred, or any act or thing done or required to be done, shall not be affected by
this Order and shall continue to remain valid and have effect as if this Order had
not been enacted.
(2) This Order shall not affect any inquiry, investigation or proceedings
commenced or pending before the commencement of this Order and every such
inquiry, investigation or proceedings may be continued and dealt with as if this
Order had not been enacted.
(3) In so far as it is necessary for preserving the effect of any written law or
document, any reference in such written law or document to the Authority for
Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam shall, as from
the commencement of this Order, be construed as a reference to the Authority for
Infocommunications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam.
Made this 20th. day of Rejab, 1447 Hijriah corresponding to the
lOth. day of January, 2026 at Our Istana Nurul !man, Bandar Seri Begawan,
Brunei Darussalam.
HIS MAJESTY
THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN,
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
